description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages the data and rendering logic for employee membership features in the HRM system, including retrieving services, setting Vue components, and handling access permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipController
classes.description: Controller class handling employee membership operations, including rendering views and managing permissions for employee membership details in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembershipService.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the service container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component props for rendering the employee membership view, based on the provided HTTP request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups relevant for capability and permission checks.
